title: Chapter 68
text:
Sixty fist-sized glossy black spherical bombs were neatly stacked in two weapon boxes. These were the Time Delay Fragmentation Grenades that Han Xiao had bought from Division 13. From this crappy name, Han Xiao knew that the explosive power of these bombs was not to be underestimated.

One bomb cost 800 Aquamarine Dollars, and sixty cost 48,000 Aquamarine Dollars.

The bombs were ready-made, and Han Xiao had only modified them. Using [Basic Mechanical Engineering], he had installed a mini propeller on the bombs. The propeller was powered by a LV 5 battery, and it had temporary power. There was no need to throw it manually, and it could fly automatically, greatly increasing the attack range.

However, the design was a little weird. Han Xiao had experimented with it a few times, and the image of a round-headed blue raccoon would always appear in his mind.

Face Simulator, Enhanced Berserk Eagle Pistols, Lightweight Mechanical Arm, Foldable Platinum Battle Knife, Cloud Swallow Glider, Magnetically Controlled Retractable Armor, and sixty Time Delay High Explosive Grenades. Han Xiao's equipment had been completely upgraded, and he could even get a variety of miscellaneous items from Division 13. At his current level, he was already a set of demigod equipment.

"This equipment is more than enough for now."

Han Xiao crossed out 'personal equipment upgrade' from his to-do list, and the next item was the vehicle.

It would take too long to build a vehicle on its own, so it was better to just buy it and modify it.

After choosing for a long time, Han Xiao decided on the type of vehicle. A heavy truck with a detachable cargo compartment that could be used as a mobile warehouse or workshop. It would also be used as the logistics vehicle for his team.

Han Xiao bought the vehicle from Division 13 directly. The products from the Military Factory were definitely of high quality. He had two choices. One was to buy it with money, and the other was to exchange for it with reputation points, which meant that Division 13 would give it to him.

After calculating his funds, Han Xiao was left with about 2,800,000 Aquamarine Dollars. It had only been a few days, but the Mechanic class's ability to spend money like water was starting to show. If Han Xiao did not know how to make money, he would not have been able to afford it.

If Han Xiao was not used to being a good Mechanic, he would not be able to become a good Mechanic.

Han Xiao chose to exchange for it with reputation points, which cost him 150 Division 13 Contribution Points. If he had spent money, it would have cost him more than 800,000 Aquamarine Dollars. Han Xiao asked Feng Jun to help him with the application.

"Give me the vehicle. How long will it take?"

"I need to get a car from the military factory. It'll take about two hours."

As it turned out, Feng Jun was a punctual person. He drove a heavy truck over with a stopwatch.

So here's the problem … Don't worry, it's impossible for a blue shit excavator to appear here.

Cough, cough, here came the problem. The truck was too big to park in the maintenance shop.

No matter how much he thought about it, he missed out on this. This was very embarrassing.

The two of them stared at each other in the alley of the repair shop.

"What do we do now?"

"Why don't you help me expand it again?"

"Forget it, the engineering department doesn't have that much free time!"

Han Xiao scratched his chin and his eyes lit up. "Didn't you bring a team to monitor this area? Where is your base?"

"Be more rational, you bastard. Do you think we're not showy enough?"

Han Xiao sized up the military heavy truck. It was four meters tall and three and a half meters wide. Behind the truck was an enlarged cargo compartment that he had specifically requested. It was eleven meters long and was even wider than the front of the truck.

"How is it showy? I don't think so." Han Xiao's face was not red and he was not panting.

Feng Jun directly spat saliva on Han Xiao's face. "Only a blind person can't see such a big truck!"

"Why are you spitting saliva when you're talking?" Han Xiao grabbed Feng Jun's sleeve and wiped his face. With a look of disdain, he said, "It's not that I want to say this, but your saliva is a bit too much."

At this time, Old Man Lu walked out and exclaimed, "Wow, what a big truck."

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. "Why don't we flatten the repair shop?"

"Get out of here." Old Man Lu unhappily scolded. He rubbed his bald head and thought for a while. Then, he took out a key from his pocket and threw it to Han Xiao.

"I have a garage a few streets away. I'll lend it to you."

Han Xiao was surprised. "How generous, Old Man Lu. Did you take the wrong medicine today?"

"Go play somewhere else!" Old Man Lu scolded. He pushed the two people blocking the alley away and walked away leisurely.

…

Han Xiao drove and arrived at the garage ten minutes later.

"Blergh —"

"Hey, hey, do you have to go that far?"

Ma Jie's face was pale. He was holding on to the car window, vomiting and waving his hands frantically.

Han Xiao did not know what Feng Jun meant. Was he saying that he would never sit in his car again? Or was he saying that he did not need to care about his feelings?

Han Xiao shook his head and threw this irrelevant question to the back of his mind. After sending off the wobbly Feng Jun, he began to modify the military truck.

He checked the truck from front to back. There were no bugs or cameras.

The quality of the products from the military factory was reliable. The interior was constructed with ten cylinders, turbochargers, and other equipment to increase horsepower. The truck could reach a maximum speed of 135km/h. There were five wheels on each side, and all of them were large and thick anti-skid and wear-resistant tires. The cargo compartment was large enough to fit a lot of equipment. Han Xiao planned to modify it into a small workshop, so he needed to move the equipment from the workshop.

The chassis was specially designed for off-road use. It was equipped with spring suspension and air suspension, so it could be driven safely in harsh terrain. It was also equipped with a drill protection device to prevent small vehicles from drilling into the chassis. The scenes in movies where the protagonist drove a sports car and drilled into a truck's crotch and fought a battle of wits and courage with the villain would never happen … Wait, why did he automatically put himself in the shoes of the villain?

The cab was not cramped at all. There was more than enough space for six people. It was equipped with a multi-gear transmission. There were ten gears, so the shifting was smooth and the brakes were in good condition.

Han Xiao checked the airbags. There were eight in total. As long as he did not fly out during a collision, he would not be hurt. He could even feel the pleasure of being stuffed in a big chest.

Speaking of collision, the front of the truck did not have a reinforced bumper, so he had to install it manually. Han Xiao looked at the windshield again. He did not cut corners. It was bulletproof.

Overall, it was in line with the rules. There was no need for major changes. Han Xiao decided to install a few nitrogen cylinders for acceleration. The heavy truck was equipped with nitrogen acceleration. It was exciting just thinking about it. As long as it did not leak, it would be better than a road hog.

Han Xiao started the modification.

The cargo compartment had been turned into a small workshop. The chassis and bumper had been reinforced, and the thick armor looked very sturdy. Four nitrogen accelerator cylinders were installed inside the cargo compartment so that it could charge forward when necessary. Han Xiao had also bought some spare tires and installed a small radar antenna on the roof of the vehicle to receive radio signals and transmit wifi.

The total cost was more than 100,000 yuan. Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. Modifying a vehicle was such a waste.

Looking at the black heavy truck in front of him, Han Xiao scratched his chin. He suddenly felt that it was a good idea to give the truck a name.

With a huge body and a dark appearance, a very reasonable name jumped into his mind.

"Big Black!"
